verdict.rationale: FFmpeg is a single-invocation media transcoding CLI and set of libraries, so scheduling recurring jobs is outside its product category. In this kind of tool, scheduling falls to the host OS (e.g., cron). Nothing in the evidence shows FFmpeg shipping any scheduler, and user-written batch wrappers are workarounds that earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
